Start Recorder Editor Synth Practice Metronome Tuner BPM Analyzer

Audio Tools. Eight tools, one tempo, one library. Everything is done by touch.

Start

Tap a small dot
On the home screen, opens that tool.
Press the orb, drag out
Pick a tool by direction. Let go to open it. Let go near the orb to cancel.
Tap bottom-left
Inside a tool, goes home. The tool stops. A recording in progress is saved first.
Hold bottom-left, drag
Jump to another tool. Sideways steps forward, up steps back. Let go on the one you want.

Everywhere

Tap a number
Opens a wheel for an exact value. Spin it, then tap the middle row or outside to confirm. The small x cancels.
Hold an object
Small buds fan out. Drag onto one and let go.
Two-finger tap
Undo, in the editor and the synth.
Bottom-left
Always the way home. Nothing else ever sits there.

What is shared

  • One tempo. The metronome sets it as you change it. The BPM detector sets it when you select part of a song. The editor grid and the synth pattern follow it.
  • One library. Recordings, opened files, editor mixes and synth captures all land there, and every tool can open them. Audio is stored on this device only, as mono.

Hints

A ghost hand shows a gesture once, the first time it is useful. Do the gesture and it goes. The book beside it opens this page.

Recorder

Record, keep what just happened, send it to the editor.

Centre dot

Tap
Start a take. Tap again to stop. The first tap asks for the microphone.
Drag down
Keep what the microphone just heard, 10 seconds to 2 minutes. The further you drag, the longer. Let go to save. Needs the ring running.

While recording

Tap anywhere else
Drop a marker.

Takes, the strips below the dot

Tap
Play. Tap again to stop.
Swipe right
Export as WAV.
Swipe left
Delete. There is no undo.
Hold
Buds: place on the editor timeline, export, delete.

Corners

Top-right
Open a file. It becomes a take.
Bottom-right
Turn the look-back ring on or off. Off clears it.

Good to know

  • The ring holds the last 2 minutes, only while the microphone is open in this tool.
  • The list shows the six newest takes. Older ones are in the other tools' wheels.
  • With the microphone open, an iPhone plays through the quiet earpiece. Use headphones.
  • It cannot record with the screen locked.

Editor

Up to 8 tracks standing side by side. Time runs down the screen, so a clip's top is its start.

Timeline

Bottom dot
Play or stop.
Tap empty space
Put the playhead there.
Drag empty space
Scroll time. Sideways scrolls the tracks when there are more than four.
Pinch
Zoom.
Two-finger tap
Undo, 40 steps.

Clip

Tap
Select it. Its settings open bottom-right. Tap empty space to close them.
Hold the middle
Buds: cut, copy, move, delete. Drag onto one and let go.
Drag the top or bottom edge
Trim. A warped clip stretches instead.
Hold an edge, then drag inward
Fade. Drag back to the edge to remove it.
Twist with two fingers
Reverse. Turn it past a quarter turn, then let go.

Where two clips touch

Drag
Move the cut.
Hold, then drag
Crossfade.

Clip settings

Warp
The clip follows the shared tempo and keeps its pitch, or not. Mode: beats, tones or repitch.
Numbers
Original tempo, transpose, gain. Tap for a wheel, or drag up and down. Sideways is finer.
Curve
The shape of the fades.

Corners and heads

Top-left +
Add a track.
Hold a track's dot
Mute, solo, remove.
Bottom-right
Snap, push, add a take or a file at the playhead, save the mix. Tap save again within 6 seconds to share the WAV.

Good to know

  • The timeline never ends. Playback stops after the last clip.
  • Nothing you do changes the recording itself.
  • The mix is mono for now. Muted tracks stay out of it.

Synth

You don't turn knobs here, you grow sounds. The seed in the middle is the sound. It plays a pattern in the shared tempo.

Seed

Tap
Play or stop. It answers just after you lift.
Double-tap
Mute the seed.
Drag out
Grow a branch, a mutated copy you hear as you drag. The direction picks how it mutates, the distance how far.
Let go far out
The branch becomes the new seed. Let go close in and nothing changes.
Rest while dragging
Half a second leaves an anchor. Let go on it to park the branch beside the seed, up to six.
Hold still
A ring fills, then the wave menu opens. Drag onto a bud and let go. Rest on a value, then slide up or down. Sideways is finer.

Parked branches

Tap
On, then focused, then off. Edits go to the focused one.
Drag
Mutate it again. Drop it on the seed to remove it.

Edges

Top-left
Tap: effects on or off. Hold: drive, crush, filter, comb. The small dots beside it turn one off.
Top-right
Tap: next setup. Hold and drag: pick one.
Left dots
Hold: the sound's settings by group. Drag to one, rest, slide.
Bottom-right
Hold: every setting as a spiral. Rest on a dot, then slide.
Right dot
Tap: put the last 30 seconds on the editor timeline. Drag down: choose up to 4 minutes.

Good to know

  • The synth always remembers the last 4 minutes it played, until you leave the tool.
  • Two-finger tap undoes, 20 steps.
  • Your seed and branches come back next time.

Practice player

Slow a song down, change its key, loop the hard part.

Bottom dot

Tap
Play or pause.
Drag sideways
Speed, 50 to 150 %.
Drag up or down
Pitch, up to 12 semitones either way.

Waveform

Tap
Jump there. Tap inside a loop to clear it.
Drag
Scrub.
Hold, then drag
Mark a loop. It snaps to half-beats when the song has a tempo.

The rest

Top-right
Choose a take or open a file.
Bottom-right
Trainer. Each loop pass adds 5 % speed, up to 100 %.
Tap a number
Speed, pitch or tempo on a wheel.

Speed and pitch are independent. The tool remembers your take, position and speed.

Metronome

The ring is the bar. Its marks are the beats.

Bottom dot

Tap
Start or stop.

Centre

Tap in time
Set the tempo from your taps.
Drag sideways
Tempo.
Drag up or down
Number of beats, 2 to 300.
Hold still
Exact tempo on a wheel.

Ring

Tap near a mark
Normal, then accent, then muted, then back.
Drag around
Turn the tempo like a dial. Further from the ring is finer.

Beats and accents are kept. It stops when you leave the tool.

Tuner

The line is straight and green when you are in tune.

Tap anywhere
Start listening.
Bottom-right
Stop or start the microphone.
Top-right number
The A reference, 415 to 466 Hz, on a wheel.

Reads about 52 to 1500 Hz.

BPM detector

The whole song as one vertical strip, with its tempo. Sections with different tempos are found for you.

Strip

Drag
Select a part. Its tempo becomes the shared tempo.
Drag a white line
Move that end of the selection.
Tap
Select that section.
Double-tap
Select the whole song.

Dots

Top-right
Open a file.
Bottom row, left to right
Record from the microphone. Half or double the tempo: hold and drag to a bud, tap to reset. Bottom-right: tap for the whole song, hold for a take wheel.
Tap the tempo
Set the shared tempo exactly on a wheel.

Opening a song does not change the shared tempo. Selecting does. Reads 50 to 215 BPM, the first 10 minutes. A selection needs at least 2 seconds.

Analyzer

Spectrum, spectrogram and loudness of the microphone or any take.

Tap the dot
Listen or stop.
Hold or flick the dot
Choose a view: spectrum, spectrogram, loudness. Drag onto one and let go.
Top-right
Source: microphone, a take, or a file.
Bottom-right
In the spectrum, cycle dots, outline, fill.
Tap the top
In loudness, reset the readings.

Loudness turns green within 1 LU of −14 LUFS. P is the sample peak of the last 3 seconds, R is the RMS of the last 0.4.
